messages:
rachel_sales: Heads-up: Greenfield Learning (YC W23) — edtech platform — asking for a $10k trial credit + temporary dedicated instance for a 4-week pilot. Main workload is embeddings-heavy search + chat. They also asked about an EDU discount and whether startup credits from our promo apply.

carol_dealdesk: FYI our standard one-off POC credit cap is $5k without a signed commit. Over $5k needs either a prepaid commit or exec sign-off. EDU discounts require verification of non-profit/edu status.

tom_solutions: Operational notes: we can reduce token spend by batching embeddings and capping context. For a short pilot we can set a strict usage cap and lower model tier. That should keep expected burn under ~1.5M tokens.

ana_security: please share their SCQ and data flow diagram. For anything involving student data we need a DPA + Student Data Addendum (SDA). Hosted POC with data anonymization preferred; dedicated increases review time (~10 business days) and needs KMS decision.

rachel_sales: They sent the SCQ link and a short privacy policy. They say data will be pseudonymized but may include transcripts. CTO (marcus_cto) offered to sign a minimal commit if needed.

carol_dealdesk: Proposed options: (A) Approve $5k trial credits immediate + EDU promo (if verified) for public credits OR (B) Approve $10k conditional on a 3-month $1k/mo minimum commit and signed SDA + DPA. No stacking with existing promo credits unless legal okays it.

tim_legal: I'll review the SDA + DPA templates. If they require special student-data clauses, that'll be a redline. Please ping me with the SCQ and PRD link.

infra_bot: Note: Dedicated sandbox provisioning ETA 10 business days; one-time provisioning fee per rate card. See: https://internal.redwood/dedicated-ratecard

rachel_sales: They prefer dedicated for isolation but will accept hosted with redaction if that gets them live quicker. Ask: can EDU promo be used with a dealdesk credit approval?

carol_dealdesk: Short answer: not by default. EDU promo is for verified edu orgs and cannot be stacked with bespoke credits. If they are non-profit edu and we want to be generous, we can do $7.5k combined but need finance + legal sign-off.

tom_solutions: Recommended POC config to limit cost: 1) embeddings in batches of 256 2) use short context window for chat 3) enable prefix caching 4) instrumentation on prompt tokens (auto-alert at 75% of cap). I'll draft config.

ana_security: If hosted, we require redaction rules and export-limited logs. If dedicated, confirm whether customer will bring keys. KMS: customer-managed keys require extra paperwork.

rachel_sales: Action items: I'll get their non-profit proof and signed sponsor note. tom will post the config + token projections. tim will review SDA. carol will prep conditional credit memo for $7.5k / $10k scenarios. infra_bot: start dedicated queue only if customer confirms and signs provisioning fee.

carol_dealdesk: Quick example terms for discussion:
```
OPTION_A: trial_credit: $5000
expiry_days: 60
edu_promo: subject_to_verification
stacking_allowed: false
OPTION_B: trial_credit: $10000
commit: $1000_per_month_for_3_months
expiry_days: 90
provisioning_fee_dedicated: $1200_one_time
SDA_required: true
```

tim_legal: I'll prioritize SDA review once they share SCQ + sponsor note. If student-data language is extensive, timeline extends.

rachel_sales: Thanks all. I'll update when I have the non-profit docs and the signed PO.

tom_solutions: I'll post the expected token burn + config later today.

carol_dealdesk: Once we have docs, I'll approve the memo and loop in finance for the EDU exception if needed.

ana_security: :white_check_mark: got SCQ link. Starting review.
